marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Happy Relationships at Home, Work & Play

Why do some relationships give us great joy and others become toxic? Are our relationship skills weakening in the age of social media? In this insightful, warmly written book, Lucy Beresford cuts to the chase of how to have harmonious relationships that really serve us. Beresford looks at different scenarios and how to deal with common problems and obstructions in our connections with the most important people in our lives, whether that's our partner, our boss or our mother.As well as being a helpful toolkit in dealing with everyday dilemmas, the book is intended to boost self-confidence, encourage understanding and empower the reader to be the best they can be in all their relationships.
